title: pvUnstructuredNetCDFPOPreader
body:
## pvUnstructuredNetCDFPOPreader

Reads Parallel Ocean Program (POP) NetCDF output (.pop.nc, .pop.ncdf) and converts its logically structured grid into an unstructured grid on a sphere: horizontal positions come from a companion GRID.nc file in the same folder, and each layer's depth_t is subtracted from an Earth radius of 6371000 (metres), so deeper layers lie closer to the sphere's centre. Stride subsamples and VOI crops the structured index space before conversion. Use pvNetCDFPOPreader for the structured form.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The GRID.nc file must sit beside the data file; without it the lat-lon mapping fails.
- VerticalVelocity is computed only for a vector grid read over the full depth range with k stride 1.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `UnstructuredNetCDFPOPreader`. Identity: `sources/UnstructuredPOPReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Stride` | This property indicate the number of indices per dimension (i,j,k) to skip between each point included in this output. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `VOI` | Index box [imin, imax, jmin, jmax, kmin, kmax] of the structured POP grid to read, counted after Stride is applied (zero-based, inclusive). It is applied only when at least one maximum is not -1; a bound outside the data is ignored. Use it to read a region of a large ocean grid. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |
| `VerticalVelocity` | If there is a velocity vector with only 2 components, specify that the reader should compute the third component. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvUnstructuredNetCDFPOPreader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
